turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for calling Northwind Financial, my name is Imani. Just so you know, this call is recorded for quality and training. How can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Morning. I'm calling about a fee I don't recognise.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's the monthly maintenance fee. It applies below a two thousand dollar balance.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I was told there'd be no fees when I opened this.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The fee schedule was in the account agreement.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm saying the fee is correct per the agreement.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That's not what I asked. I was told no fees. Someone lied to me.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can request a one-time courtesy reversal.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: One time? I've paid this for six months.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Then get me someone who can authorise six.

action_items: Request supervisor authorisation for six months of fee reversals
